name: get_my_context
title: Get My Context
description: Read-only lookup with no side effects - safe to call repeatedly. Requires authentication: returns only the caller's own context (never another user's data): first name, active school, the students they are a guardian for, and their role codes at that school. This is the context-discovery call - most other tools need a student_id or school_slug from here, and admin-role checks come from roles. Returns live account state, so call again if the user may have switched schools or had roles changed.

students.description: Students the user is guardian for (id, firstName, schoolSlug)

roles.description: Role codes the user holds at the active school

name: get_my_wallet_balance
title: Get My Wallet Balance
description: Read-only lookup - never moves funds or has side effects. Requires authentication: returns only the caller's spendable wallet balance at their active school (wallets are scoped per school, so a balance at one school does not apply elsewhere), in cents and formatted. Live value reflecting orders and refunds up to the current moment - recheck before assuming funds are still available. Call before pay_lunch_order_draft or register_for_event to confirm the user can cover the charge; not needed for read-only lookups.

balanceFormatted.description: Balance formatted with the currency symbol

currency.description: ISO currency code (CAD, USD, or MXN)

topUpUrl.description: Regional Paxaver wallet top-up page - hand this URL to the user when funds are low. Topping up happens on the Paxaver site, never through this tool

name: list_my_wallet_transactions
title: List My Wallet Transactions
description: Read-only lookup with no side effects - safe to call repeatedly. Requires authentication: returns only the caller's own wallet transaction history (type, amount, running balance, description, status, timestamps, school) - never card numbers, payment-method identifiers, or checkout links. Defaults to the active school; pass all_schools: true for every school the user belongs to, or student_id (own students only) to narrow to one student. Cursor-paginated, newest first: pass the returned nextCursor as cursor for the next page. topUpUrl is the regional top-up page on the Paxaver site for when the user asks to add funds. Filters combine with AND.

student_id.description: Filter to transactions for a specific student (must be your own student, from get_my_context)

school_slug.description: School slug to scope history to (must be a school the user belongs to); defaults to the active school

all_schools.description: When true, return history across every school the user belongs to; ignored when school_slug is also given

start.description: Range start, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC day) or an ISO timestamp with timezone

end.description: Range end, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC day) or an ISO timestamp with timezone

cursor.description: Pagination cursor - pass the nextCursor value from the previous response

balanceBeforeCents.description: Wallet balance before the transaction, in cents

balanceAfterCents.description: Wallet balance after the transaction, in cents

paymentMethod.description: Coarse payment-method label (e.g. wallet, stripe) - never a card or account identifier

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp the transaction was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp the transaction was last updated

currency.description: ISO currency code (CAD, USD, or MXN)

transactions.description: Transactions matching the filters, newest first

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page; null when there is none

topUpUrl.description: Regional Paxaver wallet top-up page - hand this URL to the user when they ask to add funds. Topping up happens on the Paxaver site, never through this tool

name: list_my_lunch_orders
title: List My Lunch Orders
description: Returns lunch orders already placed - items, menu date, status, and total - for the authenticated user's students, newest first (up to ~100 most recent). Filters combine with AND: student_id narrows to one student; menu_date and month narrow the date range, and if both are given menu_date wins. With no filters returns recent orders across all of the user's students. Admins (pac_cordinator, lunch_cordinator) see school-wide orders; parents only their own students. For what can be ordered (menu and prices), use get_lunch_menu.

student_id.description: Filter to a specific student (must be your own student, from get_my_context; admins may filter any student in the school)

menu_date.description: Single day to query, YYYY-MM-DD; omit when using month

month.description: Calendar month to query, YYYY-MM; omit when using menu_date

menuDate.description: Date the lunch is served, YYYY-MM-DD

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp the order was placed

name: get_lunch_menu
title: Get Lunch Menu
description: Returns the orderable lunch menu for the user's active school - item names, prices, dietary tags, and remaining quantity. Pass date for a single day or month for a per-day listing across the whole month (today if neither is given); if both are passed, date wins. The menu_item_id values returned are required by create_lunch_order_draft. For orders already placed, use list_my_lunch_orders.

date.description: Single day to show, YYYY-MM-DD; omit when using month

month.description: Calendar month to show, YYYY-MM; omit when using date. Today is used when neither is given

date.description: Date this menu applies to, YYYY-MM-DD

menuItemId.description: Menu item ID for ordering tools

name: create_lunch_order_draft
title: Create Lunch Order Draft
description: Creates an unpaid draft lunch order with one or more items - nothing is charged until pay_lunch_order_draft commits it. Use for multi-item orders or when the user should review the total first; each items entry pairs a menu_item_id with a quantity. The draft total is the sum of item prices times quantities plus nothing else until pay_lunch_order_draft. To change or abandon the draft, use update_lunch_order_draft or discard_lunch_order_draft. FINANCIAL - confirm student, items, and date before calling.

student_id.description: Student ID (must be your own student; from get_my_context); required when the user has more than one student, defaults to their only student

school_slug.description: School slug (from get_my_context); defaults to the active school

menu_date.description: Date the lunch is served, YYYY-MM-DD

items.description: Line items to order; get IDs from get_lunch_menu. The server prices each item from the menu - a client-sent price is ignored

id.description: Draft order ID - pass to pay_lunch_order_draft

schoolSlug.description: School the order was placed at

menuDate.description: Date the lunch is served, YYYY-MM-DD

itemTotalCents.description: Item total in cents - charged on finalize

name: pay_lunch_order_draft
title: Pay Lunch Order Draft
description: Commits a draft order from create_lunch_order_draft and charges the wallet for the item total plus optional tip_cents (donated to the school's PAC). Wallet-only: if the balance cannot cover the full total, the call fails with an error directing the user to open the Paxaver panel and top up the wallet balance, then retry - no card payment is offered through this tool. Not for new orders - use create_lunch_order_draft first. FINANCIAL - confirm the total before calling.

order_id.description: Draft order ID from create_lunch_order_draft - must still be in draft status; already-finalized orders are rejected

tip_cents.description: Tip in cents (donated to school PAC)

status.description: 'finalized' when the wallet covered the full total

name: update_lunch_order_draft
title: Update Lunch Order Draft
description: Replaces the items and/or menu_date of an unpaid draft order before it is finalized - the caller must own the draft and it must still be in draft status (order_id from create_lunch_order_draft). Pass the complete items list: it replaces the draft's items wholesale and the total is recomputed from menu prices times quantity. Only draft orders can be updated; once finalized, use cancel_my_lunch_order. WRITE - confirm the new contents with the user.

order_id.description: Draft order ID from create_lunch_order_draft - must still be in draft status

items.description: Replacement line items (menu_item_id from get_lunch_menu + quantity); replaces all existing items when provided

menu_date.description: New date the lunch is served, YYYY-MM-DD

name: discard_lunch_order_draft
title: Discard Lunch Order Draft
description: Permanently discards an unpaid draft order - the caller must own it and it must still be in draft status (order_id from create_lunch_order_draft). Nothing was ever charged, so there is no refund; the draft is simply deleted. For a finalized order use cancel_my_lunch_order instead. DESTRUCTIVE - confirm with the user before discarding.

order_id.description: Draft order ID from create_lunch_order_draft - must still be in draft status

name: cancel_my_lunch_order
title: Cancel My Lunch Order
description: Cancels a finalized order and refunds the charge to the wallet. Only works before order labels have been sent; after that the request is rejected and the order stands. DESTRUCTIVE - confirm with the user before cancelling.

order_id.description: ID of a finalized order - from list_my_lunch_orders; the order must still be finalized and not yet have labels sent

refundCents.description: Amount refunded to the wallet, in cents

balanceCents.description: Wallet balance after the refund, in cents

name: list_school_events
title: List School Events
description: Returns upcoming events for the user's active school: date, times, location, and whether registration is closed. The event IDs returned feed register_for_event and get_school_event - call get_school_event on an event for its volunteer shifts (whose IDs feed sign_up_for_volunteer_shift). To review or undo your own registrations and signups, use list_my_event_registrations / cancel_my_event_registration and list_my_volunteer_signups / cancel_my_volunteer_signup. Optionally filter by date range.

start_date.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive); omit for all upcoming events

end_date.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive); omit for all upcoming events

id.description: Event ID - input to get_school_event, register_for_event, update_school_event, cancel_school_event

events.description: Upcoming events matching the date range

name: get_school_event
title: Get School Event
description: Read-only lookup with no side effects - safe to call repeatedly. Returns one event's full detail for the selected school: date, times, location, capacity, ticket price, status, its volunteer shifts with remaining slots (cancelled shifts excluded), and the caller's own signups on those shifts. Get event_id from list_school_events. The shifts' id values are the shift_id input to sign_up_for_volunteer_shift; the mySignups entries' signupId feeds cancel_my_volunteer_signup.

school_slug.description: School slug (defaults to the active school)

id.description: Volunteer shift ID - input to sign_up_for_volunteer_shift

shifts.description: Volunteer shifts attached to the event; cancelled shifts are excluded

mySignups.description: Caller's active signups on this event's shifts; cancelled signups are excluded

name: list_event_attendees
title: List Event Attendees (Admin)
description: ADMIN: Read-only attendee list for one school event - the ticket ids needed by check_in_event_ticket, attendee first/last name, ticket quantity, status (paid, reserved, checked_in, cancelled) and check-in time. Contact details and payment data are intentionally not included - this is the minimum needed to run a check-in desk. Paginate with per_page and offset; hasMore says whether another page exists. Requires pac_cordinator or event_cordinator role. Get event_id from list_school_events.

school_slug.description: School slug (defaults to the active school)

offset.description: Rows to skip for the next page (default 0)

checkedInAt.description: ISO timestamp the ticket was checked in; null until then

attendees.description: Attendee tickets for the event, newest first

name: create_school_event
title: Create School Event (Admin)
description: ADMIN: Creates a school event, optionally ticketed, at the active school. To change an existing event use update_school_event; to register a parent for an event use register_for_event. Requires pac_cordinator or event_cordinator role. WRITE - only create on explicit user request.

name: update_school_event
title: Update School Event (Admin)
description: ADMIN: Partially updates an existing school event - only the provided fields change; omitted fields keep their current values. Use for reschedules, capacity or price changes, and status transitions (cancelled/completed). Prefer cancel_school_event to cancel outright. Requires pac_cordinator or event_cordinator role. WRITE operation - confirm changes with the user. Get event_id from list_school_events.

description.description: New event description shown to parents

ticket_price_cents.description: Ticket price in cents; 0 for free events

status.description: Event status - cancelled stops sales, completed closes the event

name: cancel_school_event
title: Cancel School Event (Admin)
description: ADMIN: Cancels a school event outright; cancelled events cannot be reactivated. For schedule, capacity, or price changes use update_school_event instead. Requires pac_cordinator or event_cordinator role. DESTRUCTIVE - confirm with the user. Get event_id from list_school_events.

event_id.description: Event ID - from list_school_events; cancelling is permanent and cannot be undone

name: check_in_event_ticket
title: Check In Event Ticket (Admin)
description: ADMIN: Marks one attendee ticket as checked in at the door - use ticket ids from list_event_attendees. Only tickets in paid status can be checked in; a repeat call on an already-checked-in ticket is rejected by the backend, so accidental double-calls do not corrupt state. Requires pac_cordinator or event_cordinator role. WRITE - confirm the attendee before checking in.

school_slug.description: School slug (defaults to the active school)

name: register_for_event
title: Register for Event
description: Registers the authenticated user for a school event and issues tickets to the caller (quantity is the number of tickets bought for the caller, 1 to 20 - there is no per-student split). For paid events quantity times the ticket price is charged to the user's wallet - the call fails on insufficient balance (the error includes the regional Paxaver top-up page for the user to add funds), when the event is sold out, or when registration is closed. To volunteer at an event rather than attend, use sign_up_for_volunteer_shift. FINANCIAL for paid events - confirm before registering.

event_id.description: Event ID from list_school_events - registration must still be open (check the closed flag)

school_slug.description: School slug (defaults to the active school)

name: list_my_event_registrations
title: List My Event Registrations
description: Read-only, no side effects. Returns the authenticated user's own event tickets at their active school - ticket id, event name/date/location, quantity, total paid, and status (paid or checked_in). Cancelled tickets are excluded. The id values returned are required by cancel_my_event_registration. Pair with list_school_events for events the user has not registered for.

tickets.description: Caller's event tickets at the active school

name: cancel_my_event_registration
title: Cancel My Event Registration
description: Cancels one of the authenticated user's own event tickets (ticket_id from list_my_event_registrations). Releases the reserved seats; for paid tickets the full amount is refunded to the user's wallet at that school. Only the ticket owner or a coordinator can cancel. DESTRUCTIVE - confirm with the user before cancelling.

ticket_id.description: Ticket ID from list_my_event_registrations - must belong to the caller and still be cancellable

name: list_my_volunteer_signups
title: List My Volunteer Signups
description: Read-only, no side effects. Returns the authenticated user's active volunteer signups at their school - signup id, shift title/date/times, and the parent event. Cancelled signups are excluded. The id values returned are required by cancel_my_volunteer_signup.

name: cancel_my_volunteer_signup
title: Cancel My Volunteer Signup
description: Cancels one of the authenticated user's own volunteer signups (signup_id from list_my_volunteer_signups) and frees the shift slot for others. No payment is involved. Only the volunteer themselves or an admin can cancel. DESTRUCTIVE - confirm with the user before cancelling.

signup_id.description: Signup ID from list_my_volunteer_signups - must belong to the caller and still be active

name: sign_up_for_volunteer_shift
title: Sign Up for Volunteer Shift
description: Signs the authenticated user up for a specific volunteer shift - no payment involved. shift_id identifies one shift within an event, not the event itself: get it from the event's volunteer shifts in get_school_event. The call fails when the shift is full or cancelled. To attend an event as a guest instead, use register_for_event. WRITE - confirm with the user before signing up.

shift_id.description: Volunteer shift ID - from the event's shifts in get_school_event

name: create_volunteer_shift
title: Create Volunteer Shift (Admin)
description: ADMIN: Creates a volunteer shift at the active school, optionally attached to an event (event_id must reference an event of the same school). Parents discover the new shift via the event's shifts in get_school_event or the volunteer views in the Paxaver panel, and sign up through sign_up_for_volunteer_shift. Requires pac_cordinator or pac_member role. WRITE - confirm title, date and times with the user before calling.

school_slug.description: School slug (defaults to the active school)

event_id.description: Event the shift belongs to (from list_school_events); omit for a standalone school shift

title.description: Shift title shown to parents (e.g. Setup crew)

description.description: Optional description of the work involved

name: list_school_programs
title: List School Programs
description: Returns the active before/after-school, enrichment, and camp programs for the user's active school: name, description, type, dates, price, capacity, and how many seats are already enrolled. The program ids returned feed register_for_program and the program administration tools. Optionally filter by program_type.

school_slug.description: School slug (defaults to the active school)

name: register_for_program
title: Register for Program
description: Registers one of the caller's own students for a school program (before/after-school care, enrichment, camp). Returns status 'registered' when a seat is available or 'waitlist' when the program is at capacity - the backend enforces the capacity check atomically. The response records the program fee (amountCents) owed; no wallet charge happens on this call. program_id comes from list_school_programs, student_id from get_my_context. WRITE - confirm the student and program before calling.

student_id.description: Student to register (must be your own student, from get_my_context)

school_slug.description: School slug (defaults to the active school)

notes.description: Optional note to staff attached to the registration

amountCents.description: Program fee recorded on the registration, in cents

name: list_program_registrations
title: List Program Registrations (Admin)
description: ADMIN: Lists program registrations for the active school - including waitlisted ones - with program name, student name, status, fee and notes. Use it to find the registration id for admit_program_registration or to review enrollment. Optionally filter to one program with program_id (from list_school_programs). Requires pac_cordinator role.

school_slug.description: School slug (defaults to the active school)

program_id.description: Filter to one program - from list_school_programs

amountCents.description: Program fee recorded on the registration, in cents

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp the registration was created

registrations.description: Registrations at the school, newest first

name: cancel_program_registration
title: Cancel Program Registration
description: Cancels one of the caller's own students' program registrations (registration_id from register_for_program). When the program has a waitlist, the backend automatically promotes the next waitlisted registration. Coordinators manage cancellations through the Paxaver panel. DESTRUCTIVE - confirm with the user before cancelling.

registration_id.description: Registration ID - from register_for_program; must belong to one of the caller's students

school_slug.description: School slug (defaults to the active school)

id.description: Waitlisted registration promoted to a seat

status.description: New status of the promoted registration

promoted.description: Waitlisted registration automatically promoted to the freed seat, if any

name: admit_program_registration
title: Admit Program Registration (Admin)
description: ADMIN: Manually promotes a waitlisted program registration to a seat, regardless of the current capacity count - the backend rejects registrations that are not in waitlist status. Find the waitlisted registration id with list_program_registrations. Requires pac_cordinator role. WRITE - confirm with the user before admitting.

school_slug.description: School slug (defaults to the active school)

name: list_school_restaurants
title: List School Restaurants (Admin)
description: ADMIN: Lists the active restaurants attached to a school (defaults to the active school). Inactive restaurants are not returned. The restaurant_id values returned are required by list_restaurant_menu_items, create_restaurant_menu_item, update_restaurant_menu_item, archive_restaurant_menu_item, and schedule_lunch_menu_item. Requires pac_cordinator, pac_member, or lunch_cordinator role.

id.description: Restaurant ID - input to menu-item and daily-menu tools

restaurants.description: Active restaurants attached to the school (inactive ones are excluded)

name: create_school_restaurant
title: Create School Restaurant (Admin)
description: ADMIN: Adds a restaurant to the active school so it can offer menu items via create_restaurant_menu_item. To change an existing restaurant there is no update tool - recreate or manage it in the Paxaver admin. Requires pac_cordinator role. WRITE - confirm with the user.

school_slug.description: School slug - defaults to the active school

tax_percent.description: Sales tax percentage applied to orders (e.g. 5 for 5%)

name: list_restaurant_menu_items
title: List Restaurant Menu Items (Admin)
description: ADMIN: Lists the full menu-item catalog for a restaurant, including inactive and unavailable items - this is the catalog, not what parents can order on a date (use get_lunch_menu for that). Provides menu_item_id values for update_restaurant_menu_item, archive_restaurant_menu_item, and schedule_lunch_menu_item. Requires pac_cordinator or lunch_cordinator role. Get restaurant_id from list_school_restaurants.

isActive.description: Whether the item is on the restaurant menu

isAvailable.description: Whether the item can currently be ordered

items.description: Full catalog items, including inactive and unavailable

name: create_restaurant_menu_item
title: Create Restaurant Menu Item (Admin)
description: ADMIN: Creates a new menu item on a restaurant. Only restaurant_id and name are required - set price_cents before the item can be meaningfully ordered. New items start active and available; use update_restaurant_menu_item to change them later. Requires pac_cordinator or lunch_cordinator role. WRITE operation - confirm with the user. Get restaurant_id from list_school_restaurants.

name.description: Item display name shown to parents

cost_cents.description: Kitchen cost in cents (internal margin tracking)

isActive.description: Whether the item is on the restaurant menu

name: update_restaurant_menu_item
title: Update Restaurant Menu Item (Admin)
description: ADMIN: Partially updates an existing menu item - only the provided fields change; omitted fields keep their current values. Use for renames, description edits, price changes (price_cents - FINANCIAL, confirm the new price), nutrition updates, or retiring an item (is_active=false). Day-level orderability is controlled by schedule_lunch_menu_item, not this tool. Use archive_restaurant_menu_item to remove the item permanently. Requires pac_cordinator or lunch_cordinator role. WRITE operation - confirm changes with the user. Get restaurant_id from list_school_restaurants and menu_item_id from list_restaurant_menu_items.

name.description: New display name for the item

description.description: New item description shown to parents

cost_cents.description: Kitchen cost in cents (internal margin tracking)

is_active.description: Whether the item stays on the restaurant menu - set false to retire it

isActive.description: Whether the item is on the restaurant menu

isAvailable.description: Whether the item can currently be ordered

name: archive_restaurant_menu_item
title: Archive Restaurant Menu Item (Admin)
description: ADMIN: Archives (soft-deletes) a menu item so it can no longer be ordered - the item is removed from ordering but stays on historical orders. To retire it from the restaurant menu without archiving, use update_restaurant_menu_item with is_active=false. Requires pac_cordinator or lunch_cordinator role. DESTRUCTIVE operation - confirm with the user. Get restaurant_id from list_school_restaurants and menu_item_id from list_restaurant_menu_items.

name: schedule_lunch_menu_item
title: Schedule Lunch Menu Item (Admin)
description: ADMIN: Puts a restaurant menu item on the orderable menu for a given date, optionally capping portions. This only schedules the item - to retire it entirely use update_restaurant_menu_item (is_active) or archive_restaurant_menu_item. Requires pac_cordinator or lunch_cordinator role. WRITE - confirm with the user. Get IDs from list_school_restaurants and list_restaurant_menu_items.

menu_date.description: Date the item is orderable, YYYY-MM-DD

available_qty.description: Maximum portions for the day; omit for unlimited

menuDate.description: Date the item is orderable, YYYY-MM-DD

availableQty.description: Portion cap for the day; null means unlimited
